description: Daily US Gulf Coast kerosene-type jet fuel spot price (USD per gallon) from FRED (US EIA series DJFUELUSGULF): latest value and recent history. It is a US Gulf Coast benchmark, not a Jet-A1 or European refinery index. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
